newsitem.title: VIETNAM: Vietnam central bank slashes interest rates.
newsitem.headline: Vietnam central bank slashes interest rates.

text.p: The central State Bank of Vietnam said on Tuesday that the interest rate ceiling for all dong loans had been lowered with immediate effect.
The central bank said the limit on short-term loans had been cut to 1.25 percent per month from 1.50 percent. The limit on medium- and long-term loans had been cut to 1.35 percent from 1.55 percent.
An official at the central bank said the decision to cut interest rates -- for the fourth time this year -- was made because inflation had continued to drop in September.
The annual rate of inflation dropped to 2.9 percent this month, its lowest level since the country launched economic reforms 10 years ago.
"For the first nine months the inflation rate was just 2.5 percent, so real interest rates were rather high," the official said.

He added that the central bank had also cut rates to tackle flagging demand for credit and encourage economic growth. The government is targetting gross domestic product (GDP) growth of nine to 10 percent this year.
